hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */.env|*/.env.*|*/data/models/*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Editing this file is blocked by project policy (secrets or binary model file)."}}' ;; *) echo '{}' ;; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.js) npx eslint "$f" ;; esac; } 2>&1 || true
